analysis.insight_summary: Users experience difficulties connecting a PC using Python to a [product_name] device over Modbus TCP. Key challenges include establishing a connection on the PC side and understanding register mapping. There is a lack of clear, accessible resources or examples to help users easily set up this communication.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for straightforward, clear examples and instructions for sending and receiving data between a PC and a [product_name] using Modbus TCP, with simple explanations for register mapping.
